config.rank_policy: r is tunable capacity; the r >= k(k-1)/2 requirement is retracted. r=8 chosen because it measured best, and it happens to alias nothing at k=4.
config.selection_metric: distributional (normalised ED with its denominator) and CRPS; CFM loss is never used for model or coupling comparison
config.framing: observational order-flow conditioning, NOT causal intervention estimation

chronological.name: chronological
chronological.note: last 30% of blocks held out; embargo applied to the TRAINING side only, test left intact

held_out_day.name: held_out_day
held_out_day.note: day index 3 removed before any fitting

exposure_window.name: exposure_window
exposure_window.note: window-level: train tau_max<=3.0, test tau_max>=6.0, embargo 2 reduced from 30; retention at the full 30-window embargo was 0 training windows (from this run's own embargo_sweep, not a stored constant)

exposure_block.name: exposure_block
exposure_block.note: block-level: 11 highest-median-exposure blocks test, rest train, full 30-window embargo; block median tau_max 1.21..7.44

validation.source: held-out BLOCKS of the training side, never the test split
validation.note: val_idx indexes the same concatenated population list as train_idx; the two index ranges are disjoint by construction

diagnosis.rule: SHIFT: oracles differ (paired CI excludes 0 and ratio>1.5) AND measured shift ratio>3x within-train baseline. FAILURE: oracles agree but the fitted model is worse than transferred. UNINFORMATIVE: in-split oracle normED>=1.
